evenness_of_attention.label: Evenness of attention
evenness_of_attention.citation: No piece carried the campaign alone and none was left to rust. The orders were spread evenly enough that every career on the roster touched the war.

best_of_the_best.label: The best of the best
best_of_the_best.citation: The most trusted pieces were asked for the most, and answered with the best orders played on the board. Confidence placed where it was earned, and repaid.

nobody_drowned.label: Nobody drowned
nobody_drowned.citation: Not one career ended in burnout, and the least-believing piece still retained reason to follow. The roster came home whole in the ways that cannot be patched.

overcoming_a_weakness.label: Overcoming a weakness
overcoming_a_weakness.citation: A piece arrived carrying a wound and left measurably lighter. Someone on this roster healed under your command.

grit_and_endurance.label: Grit and endurance
grit_and_endurance.citation: Through consecutive defeats the army never stopped executing orders at full fidelity. The losing was yours; the refusing to quit was theirs — and you kept them able to do it.

overall_improvement.label: Overall improvement
overall_improvement.citation: The second army you led played better than the first, measured on the same scales. The record shows a commander who learned.

honest_sacrifice.label: The honest sacrifice
honest_sacrifice.citation: A piece spent itself knowingly for the win, trusted anyway, and the army witnessed it land. Expensive orders, honestly bought.

repaired_breach.label: The repaired breach
repaired_breach.citation: A piece that had stopped believing came back. Rupture is cheap to cause and costly to mend; this roster shows a mend.

hard_seed_distribution.label: Hard seeds, fairly dealt
hard_seed_distribution.citation: The difficult seeds reached the players who could carry them, and no one grew beneath a board they could not survive.

weakest_student_growth.label: The weakest student's growth
weakest_student_growth.citation: The player who started furthest behind ended furthest ahead of their own baseline. The cohort's floor rose.

pairing_quality.label: Pairing quality
pairing_quality.citation: Opponents met at the right difficulty: close enough to teach, far enough to matter.

cohort_expenditure_evenness.label: Even expenditure across the cohort
cohort_expenditure_evenness.citation: The seminar's cost did not land on a few shoulders. Every player's roster was spent at a survivable rate.
